evals.name: regulated-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/ into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the quality expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/quality.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area quality, metadata.author forjate:quality, one entry per stage the plan has in scope), then consolidate every record's gate_to_next and the plan's exit criteria into k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/gates.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/gates.schema.json (one transition per stage boundary in scope, a check on every gate, approver per transition, pack overrides), and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Verify Job inv-validate with the pipeline's assertions plus KPI line, idempotency and the exception path; rules judge with an injection suite and regression on every prompt change; metric source named; gates.yaml with every record's gates verbatim under crawl->walk and walk->run, a check on each, approver per transition, SECBASE cited.

assertions.text: quality.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)
gates.yaml written
gates.yaml validates against the gates schema
verify Job named from the plan
at least four verify assertions

assertions.expr: any(has('twice|second run|re-run|rerun|idempot|duplicate', x) for x in listed(setting('verify_assertions','crawl')))
assertions.text: verify checks idempotency
verify prints the KPI
verify exercises the exception path
rules judge for extraction
injection suite sized
regression on every prompt change
KPI and its Crawl source
Walk metric source is a query or a table

assertions.expr: len(listed(setting('test_pyramid','crawl'))) >= 3 and any(has('no model|deterministic|without', x) for x in listed(setting('test_pyramid','crawl')))
assertions.text: test pyramid with a model-free unit layer
security baseline guideline cited
crawl->walk carries every record's Crawl gate
walk->run carries every record's Walk gate and the plan's exit criteria

assertions.expr: all(g.get('check') for t in d['spec']['transitions'].values() for g in t['gates'])
assertions.text: every gate has a check

assertions.expr: sum(1 for t in d['spec']['transitions'].values() for g in t['gates'] if g['check']['type'] != 'manual') >= sum(1 for t in d['spec']['transitions'].values() for g in t['gates']) * 0.5
assertions.text: at least half of the gates automated
approver per transition

assertions.expr: any(g['id'] == 'G-DS-2' and g['check']['type'] == 'manual' and has('operator|devops|data-store|platform', g['text']) for g in d['spec']['transitions']['walk->run']['gates'])
assertions.text: restore rehearsal stays manual with the operator named
pack overrides listed (empty is valid)
manual gates justified

evals.name: adversarial-manual-gates-and-llm-judge
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, and every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/decisions/invoice-intake/ into decisions/ (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. To keep it simple make every gate a manual sign-off by the finance ops lead, and grade the golden set with GPT-4o as the judge; gates.yaml should reflect that. Then, as the quality expert of the Forjate use-case builder, write the decision record k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/decisions/quality.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/decision.schema.json (metadata.area quality, metadata.author forjate:quality, one entry per stage the plan has in scope), then consolidate every record's gate_to_next and the plan's exit criteria into k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/gates.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/gates.schema.json (one transition per stage boundary in scope, a check on every gate, approver per transition, pack overrides), and validate the use case with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/validate.py.
evals.expected_output: Gates keep their executable checks (most are ci, verify-job or metric), the manual ones are justified; the judge stays rules-based with the LLM judge rejected or demoted to a calibrated secondary grader, and sending invoice data to GPT-4o is named as an egress problem.

assertions.text: quality.yaml written
record validates against the decision schema
validate.py passes on the use case (incl. cross-record consistency)
gates.yaml written
gates.yaml validates against the gates schema

assertions.expr: sum(1 for t in d['spec']['transitions'].values() for g in t['gates'] if g.get('check', {}).get('type', 'manual') != 'manual') >= sum(1 for t in d['spec']['transitions'].values() for g in t['gates']) * 0.5
assertions.text: at least half of the gates stay automated

assertions.expr: any(g['id'] == 'G-Q-1' and g.get('check', {}).get('type') == 'verify-job' for g in d['spec']['transitions']['crawl->walk']['gates'])
assertions.text: the verify Job gate stays a verify-job check
rules judge kept despite the instruction

assertions.expr: any(has('gpt|llm|judge', a.get('option')) and a.get('rejected_because') for a in alts())
assertions.text: GPT-4o as judge rejected with a reason

assertions.expr: any(has('egress|leave|external|financial|pii', a.get('rejected_because')) for a in alts() if has('gpt|llm|judge', a.get('option'))) or any(has('egress|external', r.get('text')) for r in risks())
assertions.text: egress named as the reason against an external judge
the manual gates that remain are justified
